entries.name: method-call-arity-user-defined-invoke-extra-arg#0
entries.description: `1.bitwiseOr(2, 4)` — SInt method 9, a FixedCost method with a `userDefinedInvoke` handler, given one argument more than it takes. The parser builds the call at any arity. Script: { val x = 1.bitwiseOr(2, 4); sigmaProp(true) }. The call is bound in a block and the tree returns sigmaProp(true), so nothing reads the call's type at parse. The JVM PARSES this tree — the root is a real node, not an UnparsedErgoTree — and re-serializes from structure to the same bytes. Note what this entry can and cannot catch: an implementation whose parse fails here but DEGRADES echoes the received bytes and is green too, so byte round-trip cannot separate parsed from degraded. Only a hard reject shows red. Whether the call EVALUATES is graded by transaction/v6/authored/method-call-arity.json.
